description: A futuristic, minimal AI search engine. User asks a question, backend uses Tavily to scrape/search the web, then feeds that context into an LLM agent which streams back a synthesized answer with citations.

design_philosophy.vibe: Futuristic but restrained. Think 'command center', not 'sci-fi movie'. Minimal chrome, generous whitespace, one accent color doing all the work.
principles: Dark-first design. Light mode optional, not required.
Motion should feel like physics, not decoration. Micro-interactions only: fades, subtle scale, smooth height changes.
No more than 1-2 animated elements visible on screen at once.
Typography carries the futuristic feel more than effects do.
Every screen should feel calm and fast, never busy or loud.

typography.notes: Use font_mono for citation numbers, source URLs, code, and metadata to reinforce the 'technical/futuristic' feel. Use font_primary for everything else. Keep font weights limited to 400/500/600/700.

shadows.note: Avoid heavy drop shadows. Use soft, low-opacity glows in the accent color instead, e.g. 0 0 24px rgba(94,234,212,0.15), to suggest energy/futurism without looking dated.

animation_guidelines.philosophy: Animations should be felt, not seen. Keep durations short (120-250ms) and easing natural.
allowed_animations: Smooth height auto-animate when answer streams in or accordion expands
Accent-colored glow pulse ONLY on the active search/loading state, nothing else
Skeleton shimmer while sources load, replaced instantly once real content arrives
Streaming text reveal (word-by-word or char-by-char) for the AI answer, like a typewriter but smooth, not blinking
avoid: Auto-playing background particle effects or animated gradients that never stop

pages.name: Landing Page
pages.goal: Communicate 'fast, intelligent, trustworthy search' in one screen. Convert visitor to sign up.
pages.layout: Single column, centered, generous vertical rhythm. No traditional multi-section marketing scroll — keep it to hero + how-it-works + CTA, max 3 sections.

sections.name: Nav bar
sections.details: Fixed top, transparent over background, becomes semi-opaque surface color with blur (backdrop-filter: blur(12px)) on scroll. Logo left, 'Sign in' + 'Get started' (accent gradient button) right.

sections.name: Hero
sections.details: Large centered headline (e.g. 'Search, reasoned.'), one-line subheadline in text_secondary, and a functional-looking search input box front and center (even if it just redirects to /auth or /dashboard on submit). Search box has a soft accent glow border on focus. Below it, 2-3 example query chips (pill-shaped, subtle border, hover lifts slightly).

sections.name: How it works
sections.details: 3-step horizontal row (stacks vertically on mobile): 1) Ask anything  2) We search the live web (Tavily)  3) Agent reasons over sources and answers with citations. Each step is a minimal icon (line-style, monochrome, accent on hover) + short label, no big illustrations.

sections.name: Final CTA
sections.details: Short, one headline + one button. Nothing else. Footer below is minimal: logo, 2-3 links, copyright, all in text_muted.

pages.background_treatment: Solid background color with one very subtle radial accent-colored glow behind the hero search box (low opacity, static, not animated) to add depth without noise.

pages.name: Auth Page
pages.goal: Fast, frictionless sign in/up. Feels like entering the product, not filling a form.
pages.layout: Centered single card (max-width ~400px) on the same dark background as landing, no split-screen imagery — keep it minimal.
elements: Card (surface_elevated background, border, rounded-lg) containing: heading ('Welcome back' / 'Create your account'), toggle or tabs between Sign in / Sign up, email input, password input, primary button (accent gradient, full width)
Divider with 'or' then OAuth buttons (Google/GitHub) styled as outline buttons with icon, monochrome icons that don't fight the theme
Small text link below card to switch between sign in/up
Inline validation states use error/success colors defined in theme, animate in with fade only, no shake effects
pages.animation: Card fades + slides up 8px on mount. Toggling between sign in/sign up cross-fades the form fields (150ms), does not resize jarringly — use smooth height animation.

pages.name: Dashboard (Main App / Chat-Search Interface)
pages.goal: This is the core product screen — where the user asks questions and sees AI-synthesized, cited answers streamed from Tavily search + agent reasoning.
pages.layout: Two-zone layout: a slim collapsible sidebar (left) for chat/search history, and a main content column (center, max-width ~760px, centered) for the active conversation. No right sidebar to keep it minimal.

sections.name: Sidebar
sections.details: Collapsible (icon-only collapsed state). Contains: 'New search' button at top (accent outline), list of past search threads grouped by date (Today / Yesterday / Previous 7 days), each item truncates with ellipsis, hover shows subtle surface_elevated background. User avatar/settings pinned at bottom.

sections.name: Main content — empty state
sections.details: Centered large search input (same visual language as landing hero box), a short greeting above it ('What do you want to know?'), and a row of suggested prompt chips below.

sections.name: Main content — active thread
sections.details: User's query shown as a right-aligned or bold minimal heading. Below it, an 'Searching the web...' status row with animated accent dots or a subtle shimmer while Tavily results are being fetched. Once sources are found, show a horizontally scrollable row of compact source cards (favicon, domain in font_mono text_muted, title truncated) BEFORE the answer text — this is the signature Perplexity-style moment. Then the AI answer streams in below as clean markdown-rendered text with inline numbered citation badges (small, pill-shaped, accent-colored, e.g. [1] [2]) that link/scroll to the source cards. Follow-up input pinned at the bottom of the viewport (sticky), same style as main search box but slightly smaller.

sections.name: Source card component
sections.details: Small rectangular card, surface_elevated background, border radius md, ~200px wide. Shows favicon (16px), domain name in font_mono uppercase small caps text_muted, and article title in text_primary truncated to 2 lines. Hover: border becomes accent, slight lift (translateY -2px), 150ms.

sections.name: Citation badge component
sections.details: Inline, small (~18px), pill or circle, accent-colored background at low opacity with accent text, font_mono numerals. Clicking scrolls/highlights the matching source card with a brief glow pulse.

sections.name: Streaming/loading states
sections.details: Three distinct states to visually differentiate: 1) 'Searching the web' (pulsing accent dot + text), 2) 'Reading sources' (skeleton source cards shimmering), 3) 'Answering' (streaming text with a thin blinking accent cursor at the end of the last rendered word, cursor is a simple vertical bar, not an emoji).

pages.animation: New thread content fades+slides in. Source cards stagger in with a 40ms delay between each (max 6 visible, rest scrollable). Answer text streams progressively rather than appearing all at once. Sidebar collapse/expand animates width smoothly (200ms), not instantly.

buttons.primary: Accent gradient background, dark text or white text depending on contrast, radius md, subtle glow shadow on hover, scale 0.98 on active press.
buttons.secondary: Transparent background, 1px border in 'border' color, text_primary text, border becomes accent on hover.
buttons.ghost: No border, no background, text_secondary, background becomes surface_elevated on hover.

inputs.default: surface background, 1px border, radius md, placeholder in text_muted, border becomes accent + soft glow on focus (no harsh outline ring).

component_library_notes.search_box_hero: Larger than standard inputs (~56-64px tall), radius lg, icon-left (search icon, line style), optional submit arrow button on the right that appears once text is entered (fades+scales in).

backend_integration_context_for_agent.note: This section is context only, not a frontend build instruction — include so the coding agent understands the data shape it's rendering.
flow: User submits query from search box (landing/dashboard).
Backend calls Tavily API to search/scrape the live web for the query.
Tavily results (title, url, snippet, raw content) are passed as context into an LLM agent.
Agent reasons over the context and streams back a synthesized answer with inline citation markers referencing which source each claim came from.

Frontend should treat the response as: sources[] (array of {title, url, favicon, domain}) that arrives first, then an answer stream (text chunks) that arrives after, with citation indices mapping back to the sources array.
backend_integration_context_for_agent.frontend_expectation: Design components to handle three async states per query (searching -> sources_loaded -> answer_streaming -> done), and be resilient to sources arriving before the answer starts streaming.

responsive_behavior.mobile: Sidebar becomes a slide-over drawer triggered by a hamburger icon. Source cards row becomes a horizontally swipeable carousel. Hero/search boxes shrink padding but keep same visual style. Bottom sticky input respects safe-area-inset for mobile browsers.

explicit_instructions_to_agent: Build exactly 3 pages: Landing ('/'), Auth ('/auth'), Dashboard ('/dashboard').
Use the color tokens and font tokens above consistently across all pages via a shared theme/config file (e.g. Tailwind config or CSS variables) — do not hardcode colors per component.
Keep animations subtle and purposeful per the animation_guidelines section — if in doubt, use less motion, not more.
Prioritize the dashboard's source-cards-then-streaming-answer pattern — this is the core differentiating UX of the product and should feel polished.
Do not add features not described here (no right sidebar, no multi-step onboarding, no theme switcher unless asked).
Keep all copy short and confident, matching a minimal/technical tone — avoid marketing fluff.
